title: Seamless handoff simulator for dual-run API interop
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Purpose: build a deterministic simulator/harness that exercises simultaneous invocations against two API runtime behaviors (current stable contract + candidate version) to validate 'handoff' semantics where streaming responses, function/tool calls, and structured output boundaries change.

Scope: implement a test harness that: (1) mirrors incoming requests to both runtimes in parallel (dual-run), (2) captures granular event streams (token events, toolcall open/close markers, structured-output envelope emissions), (3) performs alignments and divergence detection, and (4) generates actionable diffs useful for migration guidance and behavior-flag tuning.

Non-goals: this ticket does not modify the live routing or enable user-facing flags; it only provides a reproducible engineering harness + dashboards and a lightweight replay tool for PMs/SDKs. Production rollout automation and full A/B rollout infra are follow-ups.
checklist: Define event model: token, chunk, tool-call-start, tool-call-end, structured-envelope
Implement dual-run proxy that fans requests to stable and candidate runtimes
Instrument both runtimes to emit normalized event logs (timestamps, sequence ids, match keys)
Build alignment engine to map token sequences and detect reordering / truncation / duplication
Create divergence scoring heuristics (semantic, ordering, toolcall-id mismatch, time-to-first-toolcall)
Expose a web UI for per-request diffs and aggregate metrics
Add replay mode to run recorded sessions deterministically against new candidates
Ship initial runbook for PMs/SDKs on interpreting diffs and adjusting behavior flags
test_plan: Unit tests for event model serialization/deserialization
Integration tests: synthetic prompts exercising streaming-to-toolcall handoffs
Regression suite: replay 100 real recorded sessions from compatibility lab
Load test: verify dual-run overhead stays below 30% p50 latency increase at 200rps
Fuzzing: randomize toolcall boundary timing to find race conditions
Acceptance: PM signoff on 10 canonical migration scenarios with clear remediation guidance
rollback_plan: Disable dual-run proxy routing (feature toggle) to stop candidate traffic
Purge recorded sessions older than retention window from the simulator to avoid stale replays
Notify stakeholders and revert any instrumentation that affects production telemetry
Block follow-up automated rollout tasks until divergences are addressed

acceptance_criteria: Dual-run proxy can mirror 95% of production API surface types (streaming chat, streaming toolcall, structured completion) in the lab
Alignment engine reports per-request diffs with token-level mapping and labels (reordering, truncation, injection)
Replay mode reproduces recorded divergences deterministically on candidate runtime >= 90% of the time
Documentation and runbook published: how to interpret diffs and recommended behavior-flag adjustments for common migration patterns
No actionable regressions observed in the 100-record regression suite and load tests meet overhead targets
